poll.q: Aaj ki sab se bari khabar: petrol Rs377.91 aur rate 12% — aam aadmi par sab se zyada bojh kis ka?
options: ⛽ Petrol — roz ka kharcha barh gaya
📈 Interest rate — karobar aur rozgar rukega
🏏 Dono nahi — cricket ki haar zyada dukh deti hai
🤷 Sab mil kar — har taraf se dabao hai

https://mix929.com/2026/10/28/samsung-po.what: Samsung ka Q3 operating profit pichle saal ke muqable taqreeban 9 guna barh kar record level par — wajah AI chips ki demand.
https://mix929.com/2026/10/28/samsung-po.why: Memory chips AI data centers ki jaan hain, aur jab supply tight ho to chip banane wale ki chandi hoti hai — yehi wajah hai ke Samsung aur SK Hynix dono record tor rahe hain.
https://mix929.com/2026/10/28/samsung-po.next: Kya 2026 mein chip shortage aur gehra hoga, ya nayi capacity aane se daam normal honge?
https://mix929.com/2026/10/28/samsung-po.take: Meri take: AI ki race mein sab se zyada faida un ka hai jo 'bailcha' bech rahe hain — chips. Hum sirf AI tools use karte hain, asli paisa hardware mein ban raha hai.

https://em360tech.com/tech-articles/nvid.what: Nvidia ne Meta ki $97.5 billion equity offering mein $3 billion lagaye, aur Meta ke AI agent Muse par kaam gehra kiya; AMD ne $1 billion commit kiya.
https://em360tech.com/tech-articles/nvid.why: Meta ko AI infrastructure ke liye $135-145 billion kharch karne hain is saal, is liye itni bari fundraising — aur chip suppliers khud customer ke shares khareed rahe hain.
https://em360tech.com/tech-articles/nvid.next: Kya ye 'circular financing' hai — supplier customer ko paisa de, customer wapas supplier se chips khareede — ya ye sirf smart partnership hai?
https://em360tech.com/tech-articles/nvid.take: Meri take: jab chip bechne wala khud khareedne wale mein invest kare, to samajh lo game ab sirf product ka nahi, poori chain par qabze ka hai. Chhote developers ke liye lesson: ecosystem mein jagah banao, sirf tool par depend mat raho.

https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/2.what: South Korea ki AI chip startup FuriosaAI ne $620 million Series D raise kiya, valuation $2.9 billion — pichli valuation se taqreeban 4 guna.
https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/2.why: Sab Nvidia ka alternative dhoond rahe hain, khaas kar inference ke liye energy-efficient chips — aur Korea ki government khud $280 million laga rahi hai.
https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/2.next: Kya FuriosaAI waqai Nvidia ko takkar de payegi, ya ye sirf aik aur 'Nvidia-killer' headline ban kar reh jayegi?
https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/2.take: Meri take: har saal koi na koi 'Nvidia killer' aata hai, lekin jeet us ki hoti hai jo chip mass produce kar ke customer tak pahuncha de. FuriosaAI ka RNGD ab production mein hai — yehi farq hai, baqi sirf slides hain.

https://en.sedaily.com/technology/2026/1.what: LG Uplus ke do papers NeurIPS 2026 ke On-Device Intelligence Workshop mein accept hue — phone par AI tez aur kam battery kharch wali.
https://en.sedaily.com/technology/2026/1.why: AI ko phone par chalana cloud se sasta aur private hai; token optimization se processing 4.5 guna tez aur battery use 77% kam hua.
https://en.sedaily.com/technology/2026/1.next: Kya ye tech asli phones mein kab aayegi, ya sirf research paper tak mehdood rahegi?
https://en.sedaily.com/technology/2026/1.take: Meri take: asli AI revolution wohi hai jo aap ke phone mein, bina internet ke, bina battery khaye chale. Cloud wali AI sab ko dikhti hai, on-device wali AI sab ko faida degi.

https://newshub.medianet.com.au/2026/10/.what: Cognite ke mutabiq us ke Industrial AI platform use karne wali companies ne $1 billion se zyada verified, haqeeqi value unlock ki — downtime kam, production barha.
https://newshub.medianet.com.au/2026/10/.why: Factory aur energy companies ko AI se slides nahi, naapi ja sakne wali bachat chahiye — Cognite ne apni kamyabi customer ke KPI se naapi, apne license se nahi.
https://newshub.medianet.com.au/2026/10/.next: Kya baqi AI vendors bhi 'verified value' ki taraf jayenge, ya sirf pilot projects dikha kar paisa lete rahenge?
https://newshub.medianet.com.au/2026/10/.take: Meri take: AI vendor se hamesha ye poochho — 'kitne paisay bachaye, kahan, kis ne verify kiye?' Jo ye jawab na de sake, woh sirf demo bech raha hai.

https://dealroom.co/news/167621-casap-ra.what: Casap ne $56 million Series B raise kiya — us ke AI agents banks ke disputes aur chargebacks handle karte hain; total funding $90 million ho gayi.
https://dealroom.co/news/167621-casap-ra.why: Ab card fraud ka taqreeban aik tihai hissa khud cardholders karte hain — jhooti disputes — aur banks ke liye har chhota case investigate karna mehnga hai.
https://dealroom.co/news/167621-casap-ra.next: Kya AI agents banks ke back-office ka mustaqbil hain, ya customer ke haqooq ke liye ye khatra ban jayenge?
https://dealroom.co/news/167621-casap-ra.take: Meri take: AI agents ki asli kamai boring kaam mein hai — dispute, form, back-office. Jo developer 'sexy' chatbot banane mein laga hai, woh paisa wahan chhor raha hai jahan koi dekh nahi raha.

https://tribune.com.pk/story/2637445/gov.what: Petrol Rs1.85 barh kar Rs377.91 aur diesel Rs1.75 barh kar Rs399.82 per litre ho gaya, aaj 29 October se.
https://tribune.com.pk/story/2637445/gov.why: Daily pricing mechanism ke tehat qeematein global crude se jurri hain — Yemen mein larai aur Saudi refinery par hamle ke baad crude 2% barha.
https://tribune.com.pk/story/2637445/gov.next: Kal phir qeemat badlegi ya neeche aayegi? Daily mechanism mein yehi sawal roz poochhna parega.
https://tribune.com.pk/story/2637445/gov.take: Meri take: daily price ka matlab ye hai ke ab petrol ki khabar roz ki khabar ban gayi hai — aik din relief, agle din izafa. Aam aadmi ke liye budget banana ab aur mushkil, kyunke qeemat ka koi haftawar andaza hi nahi raha.

https://www.nation.com.pk/newspaper/29-O.what: State Bank ne policy rate 11.5% se barha kar 12% kar diya; business forum ne kaha is se qarza mehnga, production mehngi aur investment slow hogi.
https://www.nation.com.pk/newspaper/29-O.why: Mehngai control karna zaroori hai, lekin jab qarza mehnga ho to factory lagana, karobar barhana sab ruk jata hai — khaas kar SMEs ke liye.
https://www.nation.com.pk/newspaper/29-O.next: Kya agle review mein rate wapas neeche aayega, ya mehngai ke dabao mein mazeed sakhti hogi?
https://www.nation.com.pk/newspaper/29-O.take: Meri take: interest rate woh switch hai jo poori economy ko on/off karta hai — upar karo to mehngai rukti hai, lekin rozgar aur growth bhi ruk jati hai. Balance banana hi asal imtihan hai, aur abhi woh balance nazar nahi aa raha.

https://www.nation.com.pk/newspaper/29-O.what: Pakistan ne 2026 ke pehle 6 mahinon mein 4.5GW battery storage equipment import kiya — poori tareekh ke 9.5GW ka taqreeban aadha.
https://www.nation.com.pk/newspaper/29-O.why: Solar barh raha hai, lekin din ki bijli shaam ko kaam nahi aati — battery hi woh pull hai. 40 se zyada data centers aur EVs bhi demand barha rahe hain.
https://www.nation.com.pk/newspaper/29-O.next: Kya Pakistan apni battery industry banayega, ya sirf import kar ke aik aur import bill khara karega?
https://www.nation.com.pk/newspaper/29-O.take: Meri take: ye khabar chhoti lagti hai lekin bari hai — Pakistan chup chaap battery economy mein dakhil ho raha hai. Jo is waqt storage, solar aur EV ki skill seekh le, agle 5 saal us ke honge.

https://www.nation.com.pk/newspaper/29-O.what: PM Shehbaz Sharif ne ministries ko November tak Alibaba Group ke saath AI aur digitalisation projects ke tamam measures mukammal karne ka hukum diya.
https://www.nation.com.pk/newspaper/29-O.why: Agenda mein IT graduates ki AI training, early cancer detection, OGRA fuel analytics aur SMEs ki global market access shamil hai.
https://www.nation.com.pk/newspaper/29-O.next: Kya November ki deadline poori hogi aur projects zameen par nazar aayenge, ya ye sirf aik aur meeting ki khabar ban kar reh jayegi?
https://www.nation.com.pk/newspaper/29-O.take: Meri take: government ke AI plans aksar meeting se aage nahi barhte — farq sirf tab parega jab aik project poora ho kar awaam tak pahunche. Deadline achhi hai, lekin hisab November ke baad hoga, abhi nahi.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2040333.what: Pakistan tri-series mein Sri Lanka se 8 wickets se haar gaya — poori team 110 par out; batting coach ne mana ke batting sirf 70% par chal rahi hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2040333.why: Top order phir collapse hua — Babar 29 par out, baqi koi lambi innings na khel saka; Madushanka ne 5 wickets liye. Final haftay ko phir Sri Lanka se hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2040333.next: Kya final mein batting sudhar jayegi, ya yehi 70% wali team trophy bhi haath se nikal degi?
https://www.dawn.com/news/2040333.take: Meri take: 70% ka aitiraf imaandari hai, lekin final se pehle ye kehna bhi khatre ki ghanti hai. Cricket mein confidence achha hota hai, lekin 110 par out hone ke baad confidence se zyada technique aur plan chahiye.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2040273/rallie.what: Rawalpindi, Murree aur doosri jagahon par Kashmir Black Day rallies, seminars, solidarity walks aur photo exhibitions ke saath manaya gaya.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2040273/rallie.why: 27 October 1947 ko Srinagar mein Indian forces ki aamad ki yaad mein har saal ye din manaya jata hai — Kashmiri awaam ke haq-e-khudiradiyat ki himayat mein.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2040273/rallie.next: Kya is saal ki sargarmiyan Kashmir cause ko international attention dilane mein kuch naya kar payengi?
https://www.dawn.com/news/2040273/rallie.take: Meri take: Kashmir par har saal rallies hoti hain, lekin duniya tabhi sunti hai jab baat musalsal, documented aur naujawan nasal tak pahunche. Sirf aik din ki walk se zyada, saal bhar ki awaaz chahiye.

mood: AI chips ka paisa barh raha hai, petrol ka bojh bhi — aaj ka mood: tech upar, jeb neechay.
